Sukoon

Specialist Arabic diacritization

Sukoon adds tashkeel without turning your text into a chatbot conversation.

Paste Arabic text, choose CPU or GPU when available, and get a preserved text-in/text-out vocalization pass from the local container.

99.29% DER quality
9,281 words/sec GPU
~73 MB checkpoint

Output Contract

Preserve the base Arabic. Predict the vocalization layer.

Sukoon is built for preprocessing, publishing, education, and TTS pipelines where stable text preservation matters as much as the harakat.
